text:
mira: Heads up — bringing up heron-v2-compact quantized to int8 and seeing a measurable recall@k regression on the wiki holdout vs fp16. cc @santiago. quick numbers below and a tiny plot link: https://dash.redwood.ai/runs/17588

santiago: Thanks, Mira. Can you paste the eval config and exact quant flow? dynamic/static/per-channel? calibration set size?

mira: Eval config:
```
model: heron-v2-compact
precision: int8 (onnx per-channel symmetric)
calibration_set: wiki-holdout-1k
batch_size: 256
metric: recall@{1,5,10}, cosine
```
Results (fp16 vs int8):
fp16 R@1/5/10 = 0.721 / 0.814 / 0.885
int8 R@1/5/10 = 0.684 / 0.770 / 0.833
Plot: tiny drop concentrated in top-1 and top-5, hist of cosine shifts attached.

anya: Oof, ~4% absolute at R@1 is non-trivial. Two quick things: (1) are you centering embeddings before quant? (2) what about calibrator size — 1k might be small for per-channel scaling on long tails.

kevin: Also check embedding norm distribution changes. If quant clips tails you'll see angle distortions. Quick check I run locally:
```
# compute per-example norms
import numpy as np
n = np.linalg.norm(embs, axis=1)
np.percentile(n, [1,5,50,95,99])
```
If int8 mean norm shifts, a simple mean-centering (subtract mean, renormalize) often recovers most recall.

embed-bot: Automated run summary attached: run=17588, model=heron-v2-compact,int8,calib=1k,eval=wiki-holdout-1k,fp16_baseline=17580. CPU time 12m, tokens 0. No infra errors.

mira: Good point on centering — I ran zero-mean before the model (we normalize to unit L2) but not after quant-dequant path. Will try subtracting quantized mean and renormalize. Also switching to 10k calibration set next.

santiago: If you can kick off two forks: (A) center post-quant + renormalize; (B) increase calib to 10k and try per-channel affine (vs symmetric). Keep all seeds same. I can help with ci runner.

anya: Also add clustering metric — silhouette on a small sample and recall by length bucket (short vs long queries). Sometimes top-k drop only for short queries.

kevin: Agreed. I'll add a quick script to log R@k stratified by query length and a silhouette score. Paste here when ready and we can merge into the eval harness.

mira: Scheduling two forks now. Will post runs later today. Thanks for triage pointers :thumbsup:

santiago: Cool. If the centering recover >=80% of delta we can ship with an apply-center postprocess in the runtime as a temporary mitigation. If not, next step is small retrain/float16 distillation.

embed-bot: New runs queued: 17589 (int8-center-postproc-1k), 17590 (int8-10k-affine). ETA ~2h.

mira: noted. I'll follow up here with the run ids once complete.
